title: AI Will Wipe These Jobs Out Next
description:
AI already came for the first wave of jobs and almost nobody noticed. The next wave has a date on it. In February 2026, Mustafa Suleyman, the CEO of Microsoft AI, said most of the desk tasks of lawyers and accountants will be fully automated by AI within 12 to 18 months. My own call is 18 months.

So I go job by job and put a risk level on every one. Copywriters and graphic designers. Video editors, where I already get the job done in around a fifth of the time with AI. Actors and models, universities, accountants and lawyers. Then the flip side, and it's a big one: healthcare could get a lot cheaper.

Here's the part that has me on edge. The paychecks disappear before the prices do. The way through is to own the assets before the paychecks run out... and crypto is the one asset you can own from your phone with no gatekeeper. Mine are $BTC, $KAS and $TAO. And don't go through this alone.

#crypto #kaspa #bitcoin #AI #jobs
